correctness.rationale: For 24 arcs from the 8-vertex Hamming cube, the package checker enumerates all valid directed path forests via two complete methods (6,497 augmented faces) and derives an acyclic 3,193-pair Morse reduction. Source code was inspected for Hasse topological sorting of 29,160 cover edges, signed integer cancellation, unit Smith diagonalization and two arc orders; residual ranks of d4=2,d5=4 yield the stated free groups. Independent exhaustive faces and mod-two boundary ranks reproduce f=(24,216,928,2016,2160,1008,144) and Betti (6,45,36,12). The earlier published full-text theorem proves the exact same integral ranks, also 2-connectivity, by an alternative 3,199-pair zero-differential matching. There is no argument for other cube dimensions or wedge homotopy.
residual_risks: Full integer checker logic inspected; independent rerun covered mod-two ranks only and cannot alone rule out high-prime torsion. No wedge decomposition or higher-dimensional cube theorem. Exact prior publication makes originality decisively failed.
